text:
samir: Quick sync  we need a terse operational play for SI co-sell + marketplace + HW partners. last week the buyer got cc'd by 3 teams. we need a deterministic flow so SEs stop guessing.

claire: Agreed. Draft priority: (A) SI has contractual artifact (SOW/PO/invoice/customer-backdated-email) -> SI primary; (B) marketplace checkout with partner_token or partner_sku -> SI primary; (C) Redwood-originated inbound (trial, in-app request) -> Redwood primary; (D) simultaneous documented outreach within 10 days -> joint.

diego: Add pilot precedence: if SI or HW partner underwrites the pilot (PO/SOW dated before pilot start) they get precedence even if Redwood originally engaged. require claim asserted within 7 days of lead creation.

hana: Ops reality: partner metadata is frequently lost for hardware resellers. Heuristic idea: if sku startswith("hw_") and order_notes include an email domain from our partner list -> auto-flag for SI review; else surface to ops queue with note "needs_partner_proof". filing OPS-13800.

ops-bot: Created OPS-13800: "marketplace+hw partner detection heuristics" assigned to hana, due 2024-07-26.

claire: To reduce ping-pong we need a 4-line handoff card in SFDC: 1) one-line deal summary, 2) named buyer POC + SI & RW POCs, 3) procurement path (marketplace/PO/reseller), 4) next step owner + ETA. copyable text only.

samir: I also want a lightweight intake JSON schema for automation. proposal (different field names to avoid collision):
```
source_hint: [redwood, si, marketplace, hw_partner]
proof_link: string (required for si_claim)
proof_tag: [sow, po, invoice, email, portal_note]
claim_grace_days: 7
assigned_party: [redwood, si, joint, partner]
escalation_email: partnerships@redwood.com
```

diego: Good. Also enforce that auto-assign to SI requires proof_link containing a partner domain or a proof_tag of type [sow|po|invoice|email]. Otherwise state is "pending_evidence" and ping the SI.

hana: For disputes: do a 48h rapid triage; if unresolved by 3 business days, lock assignment to the party with earliest documented outreach and notify buyer + both parties with a short reason. call the window the "claim_assertion_window" in docs.

legal-bot: Legal note: automated locking wording needs review. Please submit final lock text to LR-812 by 2024-07-14. Keep customer-facing text minimal and reversible on manual review.

claire: Can someone own a one-pager + partner-portal blurb? ideally include a tiny flow diagram (Assert -> Validate -> Assign/Lock -> Notify) and the SFDC snippet.

samir: I'll draft the one-pager and the portal blurb. diego: can you draft the short ops email templates for assignment and lock?

diego: sure. draft templates: Assign: "Hi <buyer>, routing update: primary owner is <entity>. Next step: <action> (owner: <POC>, ETA: <date>)." Lock: "Hi <buyer>, ownership temporarily locked to <entity> after review. Contact: <POC>. Reply if you need expedited review."

hana: I'll own OPS-13800 details and SFDC field wiring; will post the tracker when ready.

ops-bot: OPS-13800 linked: https://tracker.redwood/OPS-13800 (assigned hana).

samir: Thanks team  this should cut duplicated outreach. If anyone has a short anonymized customer example where ownership confusion caused a lost meeting, drop it here and i'll redline for the playbook.
